verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no way for an agent to build or configure a Plausible dashboard through an API or MCP server. The Stats API is explicitly read-only and only returns metrics as JSON, so it is at most a building block an agent could use to assemble an external report. No MCP server is documented, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. Plausible's dashboard is a single fixed view, and nothing shows it can be created or customized programmatically.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent build a dashboard of my key metrics end-to-end via the API or MCP server
